decision: Bounded, explicit, auditable exception. Risk accepted through 2026-12-25 by Mike Diegel. This acceptance does not constitute remediation, severity reduction, or scan clearance. The scans still run in full and still report everything; the gate passes only when every blocking finding is listed here, unexpired, and version-matched. Any new ID, expired entry, or package version change fails the gate. No VEX statement, no severity reduction, no suppression file, no continue-on-error.

exceptions.exposure: ncurses infocmp CLI removed at build; SUID/SGID stripped; component probe verifies infocmp absence. Affected code is terminal-info tooling, not a library path the services call.
exceptions.review: Remove when an upstream fix lands. Re-assess if the services start using the vulnerable function (QUIC, CMS, FTS5, session changesets, DANE, AES-GCM-SIV, gettext with non-C locales). Never auto-renews.
